text: DSH Session Folders 是面向 DSH Web 的会话整理插件：它在侧栏会话列表中渲染可嵌套的文件夹树，支持自定义颜色与图标、折叠文件夹、右键移动会话、拖放归组和批量选择移动。Host 侧通过 REST API 读取和更新分组状态，并将元数据保存到本机 JSON 文件；适合希望按项目整理长期对话的 Web 用户。需要 DSH Web profile，不需要额外 API Key。

DSH Session Folders adds nested folders to the DSH Web sidebar. Organize conversations with colors and icons, collapse folders, and move sessions by menu, drag-and-drop, or batch selection. Folder metadata is stored locally through a host REST API. Requires DSH Web; no API key.
想把 DSH 侧栏里的不同项目对话分开放进文件夹。
How can I group and nest conversations in the DSH Web sidebar?
DSH Session Folders 的功能「嵌套会话文件夹」：在 Web 侧栏会话列表中显示文件夹树，可设置颜色和图标并折叠文件夹；右键或拖动会话即可归组，分组状态由 Host API 保存到本机 JSON 文件。
@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 8；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web 侧栏添加**会话分组（文件夹）**：把对话整理进可嵌套、可自定义颜色与图标的文件夹，让长期项目和零散问答不再混在一起。

插件会在会话列表顶部（`ui-workspace` 的 `treeBody`）注入一棵文件夹树，像文件管理器一样分层渲染。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · DSH Session Folders：- **整理**：文件夹支持嵌套、自定义颜色、自定义图标与折叠状态记忆。
- **交互**：右键菜单「移动到分组」、把会话拖拽到文件夹、以及批量选择模式。
- **隐藏**：已分组的会话从原生列表移除，改为在文件夹内以自有行渲染；点击时通过 `ctx.sessions.open` 打开。
- **持久化**：host 侧提供只读 / 变更 REST API（通过单调递增的 `version` 做乐观并发控制），数据写入 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json`。
- **干净**：纯 DOM 注入、零依赖，所有副作用都由 `ctx.effect` disposer 清理，卸载即净。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 快速开始：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wakeup595626-cmyk/dsh-session-folders
```

该包尚未发布到 npm，请使用上面的 GitHub 安装方式。安装或更新后重启 `dsh web`。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 使用：打开 Web UI，使用会话列表上方的文件夹树：

- 右键会话或文件夹打开操作菜单；
- 把会话拖到目标文件夹即可移动；
- 文件夹可继续嵌套、改色、改图标和折叠；
- 批量选择模式可一次移动多个会话。

REST API 位于 `/@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders/api`。
@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 环境要求：- 已安装 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，并使用 `web` profile

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 数据与兼容性：- 分组元数据默认保存在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json`，可用插件配置里的 `storagePath` 覆盖。
- 插件只管理会话的展示分组，不复制、修改或删除会话正文。
- 写操作带单调递增的 `version`，并发冲突时返回最新的完整状态，由客户端重试。
- 当前面向 DSH 的 `web` client。DSH 升级后请回归一次拖拽、嵌套和刷新后的持久化。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 第三方声明：无第三方运行时依赖；client 侧是针对 DeepSeek Harness client runtime 的原生 DOM 实现。

[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds **session folders** to the Web sidebar: nest conversations into colour- and icon-tagged folders so long-running projects stay separate from one-off questions.
@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · DSH Session Folders：A folder tree is injected at the top of the session list (`ui-workspace`'s `treeBody`), rendered like a file manager.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · DSH Session Folders：- **Organise** — folders support nesting, custom colour, custom icon and a remembered collapse state.
- **Interact** — right-click "move to folder", drag a session onto a folder, and a batch-select mode for moving many at once.
- **Hide** — grouped sessions are removed from the native list and rendered as their own rows inside their folder; clicking one opens it through `ctx.sessions.open`.
- **Persist** — the host exposes read/change REST APIs (with optimistic concurrency via a monotonic `version`) writing to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json`.
- **Clean** — pure DOM injection with zero dependencies; every side effect is disposed by a `ctx.effect` disposer, so unloading leaves nothing behind.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Quick start：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wakeup595626-cmyk/dsh-session-folders
```

The package is not published on npm yet; use the GitHub installation command above. Restart `dsh web` after installing or updating it.
@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Requirements：- A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) installation with the `web` profile

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Data and compatibility：- Folder metadata defaults to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json` and can be relocated with the plugin's `storagePath` option.
- The plugin manages presentation only; it does not copy, edit or delete conversation contents.
- Writes carry a monotonic `version`; a concurrent change returns the latest state so the client can retry safely.
- This release targets the DSH `web` client. After a DSH upgrade, recheck drag-and-drop, nesting and persistence across reloads.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Third-party notices：No third-party runtime dependencies. The client half is plain DOM against the DeepSeek Harness client runtime.

See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

插件会在会话列表顶部（`ui-workspace` 的 `treeBody`）注入一棵文件夹树，像文件管理器一样分层渲染。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · DSH Session Folders：- **整理**：文件夹支持嵌套、自定义颜色、自定义图标与折叠状态记忆。
- **交互**：右键菜单「移动到分组」、把会话拖拽到文件夹、以及批量选择模式。
- **隐藏**：已分组的会话从原生列表移除，改为在文件夹内以自有行渲染；点击时通过 `ctx.sessions.open` 打开。
- **持久化**：host 侧提供只读 / 变更 REST API（通过单调递增的 `version` 做乐观并发控制），数据写入 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json`。
- **干净**：纯 DOM 注入、零依赖，所有副作用都由 `ctx.effect` disposer 清理，卸载即净。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 快速开始：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wakeup595626-cmyk/dsh-session-folders
```

该包尚未发布到 npm，请使用上面的 GitHub 安装方式。安装或更新后重启 `dsh web`。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 使用：打开 Web UI，使用会话列表上方的文件夹树：

- 右键会话或文件夹打开操作菜单；
- 把会话拖到目标文件夹即可移动；
- 文件夹可继续嵌套、改色、改图标和折叠；
- 批量选择模式可一次移动多个会话。

REST API 位于 `/@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders/api`。
@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 环境要求：- 已安装 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，并使用 `web` profile

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 数据与兼容性：- 分组元数据默认保存在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json`，可用插件配置里的 `storagePath` 覆盖。
- 插件只管理会话的展示分组，不复制、修改或删除会话正文。
- 写操作带单调递增的 `version`，并发冲突时返回最新的完整状态，由客户端重试。
- 当前面向 DSH 的 `web` client。DSH 升级后请回归一次拖拽、嵌套和刷新后的持久化。

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · 第三方声明：无第三方运行时依赖；client 侧是针对 DeepSeek Harness client runtime 的原生 DOM 实现。

[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds **session folders** to the Web sidebar: nest conversations into colour- and icon-tagged folders so long-running projects stay separate from one-off questions.
@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · DSH Session Folders：A folder tree is injected at the top of the session list (`ui-workspace`'s `treeBody`), rendered like a file manager.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · DSH Session Folders：- **Organise** — folders support nesting, custom colour, custom icon and a remembered collapse state.
- **Interact** — right-click "move to folder", drag a session onto a folder, and a batch-select mode for moving many at once.
- **Hide** — grouped sessions are removed from the native list and rendered as their own rows inside their folder; clicking one opens it through `ctx.sessions.open`.
- **Persist** — the host exposes read/change REST APIs (with optimistic concurrency via a monotonic `version`) writing to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json`.
- **Clean** — pure DOM injection with zero dependencies; every side effect is disposed by a `ctx.effect` disposer, so unloading leaves nothing behind.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Quick start：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wakeup595626-cmyk/dsh-session-folders
```

The package is not published on npm yet; use the GitHub installation command above. Restart `dsh web` after installing or updating it.
@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Requirements：- A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) installation with the `web` profile

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Data and compatibility：- Folder metadata defaults to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/session-folders.json` and can be relocated with the plugin's `storagePath` option.
- The plugin manages presentation only; it does not copy, edit or delete conversation contents.
- Writes carry a monotonic `version`; a concurrent change returns the latest state so the client can retry safely.
- This release targets the DSH `web` client. After a DSH upgrade, recheck drag-and-drop, nesting and persistence across reloads.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-folders README · Third-party notices：No third-party runtime dependencies. The client half is plain DOM against the DeepSeek Harness client runtime.

See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
